record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, replace chronological position ranks with reverse nonpadding ranks: the final real or masked position receives position ID 1, its predecessor 2, and so on; padding remains 0. Reuse the existing positional table and retain the appended-mask state as the sole inference readout. Recency-aligned positions may transfer last-item context across variable history lengths more effectively than start-aligned ranks. Retain history length 128, bidirectional masked-target training, features, item embedding parameterization, backbone, scoring, loss and optimizer. Update the predictor writer consistently and retain one checkpoint per category.
